name: Recover lost git commits via fsck + cherry-pick
recipe_commands: GITDIR=$(find /app -name '.git' -type d 2>/dev/null | grep -v /usr | grep -v /etc | grep -v /root | head -1 | xargs dirname) && echo GITDIR=$GITDIR && cd $GITDIR && git status && git log --oneline -5
cd $GITDIR && git fsck --lost-found 2>&1 | grep 'dangling commit' | head -5
cd $GITDIR && for c in $(git fsck --lost-found 2>/dev/null | grep 'dangling commit' | awk '{print $3}'); do echo "== $c =="; git show --stat $c 2>/dev/null | head -12; done
cd $GITDIR && git checkout master && git cherry-pick <dangling-hash-with-about.html> || git merge <dangling-hash>
cd $GITDIR && git log --oneline -10 && git status && ls -la
reasoning: fsck --lost-found reveals dangling commits. Inspect each with git show --stat. The lost commit contains about.html/layout.html. Then CHERRY-PICK or MERGE it into master.
